description: This file defines the MultipleImplicitSubscriptionGrain class, a grain implementation in Orleans that subscribes to multiple implicit streams ('red' and 'blue') and maintains counters for received events.

classes.name: MultipleImplicitSubscriptionGrain
classes.description: A grain class subscribing to 'red' and 'blue' streams with counters for each stream.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Initializes stream subscriptions and prepares the grain upon activation.

methods.name: GetCounters
methods.description: Returns the current counts of received 'red' and 'blue' events.
